# openwrt_network_device (Resource)

A layer-2 device such as a bridge or VLAN (`config device`).

Manages a `device` section in `/etc/config/network`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Device name, e.g. `br-lan`. (UCI option `name`.)
- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `bridge_empty` (Boolean) Bridge: create even without ports. (UCI option `bridge_empty`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `ifname` (String) Base device for VLAN/macvlan. (UCI option `ifname`.)
- `igmp_snooping` (Boolean) Bridge: enable IGMP snooping. (UCI option `igmp_snooping`.)
- `ipv6` (Boolean) Enable IPv6 on the device. (UCI option `ipv6`.)
- `macaddr` (String) MAC address override. (UCI option `macaddr`.)
- `mtu` (Number) MTU. (UCI option `mtu`.)
- `ports` (List of String) Bridge member ports. (UCI option `ports`.)
- `promisc` (Boolean) Promiscuous mode. (UCI option `promisc`.)
- `stp` (Boolean) Bridge: enable spanning tree. (UCI option `stp`.)
- `txqueuelen` (Number) TX queue length. (UCI option `txqueuelen`.)
- `type` (String) Device type (empty for a plain device override). (UCI option `type`.) One of: `bridge`, `8021q`, `8021ad`, `macvlan`, `veth`.
- `vid` (Number) VLAN ID for 8021q/8021ad devices. (UCI option `vid`.)
- `vlan_filtering` (Boolean) Bridge: enable VLAN filtering. (UCI option `vlan_filtering`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
